visual_action: A slideshow of three professional portraits of Kamala Harris. In the first, she is seated in an armchair in a white pantsuit, resting her chin on her hand and looking at the camera. In the second, she stands against a brown backdrop, smiling at the camera. In the third, a full-body shot, she stands against the same backdrop, smiling and looking slightly off-camera.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: The video consists entirely of still photos of Kamala Harris.

spoken_summary: No speech, only music with lyrics.
audio_music: An upbeat, confident electronic pop track ('Von dutch' by Charli XCX) plays throughout, with lyrics such as "I'm your number one."
cultural_references: The song 'Von dutch' by Charli XCX is used as the audio track.
central_claim: Kamala Harris is a confident, powerful, and stylish leader.
intended_effect: To cultivate admiration and positive sentiment for Kamala Harris.
